definitions.explanation: The government of a shogun in feudal Japan. There were three major shogunates: the Kamakura (1185–1333), Muromachi (1336–1573), and Edo/Tokugawa (1603–1868) shogunates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧{幕府|ばくふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧260⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The Edo shogunate lasted about 260 years.

examples.japanese: {幕府|ばくふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れて→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The shogunate fell and the Meiji era began.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧{幕府|ばくふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{源頼朝|みなもとのよりとも}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれ→開く：01979_hiraku⟧、⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まり：02474_hajimari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The Kamakura shogunate was established by Minamoto no Yoritomo and marked the beginning of warrior-class government.

notes:
USAGE:
An essential term for understanding Japanese history. The word literally means "tent government" (⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ = curtain/tent, ⟦{府|ふ}→府：09870_fu⟧ = government office), referring to the field headquarters of a military commander. The three major shogunates are:
- ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧{幕府|ばくふ} (Kamakura shogunate, 1185–1333)
- {室町|むろまち}{幕府|ばくふ} (Muromachi shogunate, 1336–1573)
- ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧{幕府|ばくふ} / {徳川|とくがわ}{幕府|ばくふ} (Edo/Tokugawa shogunate, 1603–1868)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕府|ばくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to establish a shogunate
- {幕府|ばくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to overthrow the shogunate
- {幕府|ばくふ}{軍|ぐん}: shogunate forces
- {幕府|ばくふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧: collapse of the shogunate
